hook: Hear a hypothesis once and write it perfectly: the umlaut in hätte and wäre, the verb pile-up and the comma at the pause.
intro: Twelve hypotheses, dictated: unreal conditions in the present and the past, regrets with modals, and one-word Konjunktiv forms. The ear must catch the umlauts that make the mood — hätte, wäre, könnten, gäbe, wüsste, käme — the participles at the end of wenn-clauses followed by the helper (…gewusst hätte, …gekommen wäre, …gefragt hätten), the double infinitive with a modal (anrufen können, aufstehen sollen), and the comma between the two halves — heard as a pause, written as a comma, with the main clause starting on its verb. Three sentences have no wenn at all and start with the verb (Hätte ich das gewusst, … / Wäre das Wetter besser, …) or with a phrase (Ohne deine Hilfe …, An deiner Stelle …). Type each sentence after hearing it whole; the first word (Wenn / Hätte / Wäre / Ohne) tells you the shape.
tips[0].title: Listen for the shape from the first word
tips[0].text: Wenn … → wenn-clause, verb cluster before the comma, main verb right after. Hätte / Wäre … → wenn-less, verb first, comma, verb first again.
tips[0].check.why: A wenn-less condition starts with its verb, then a comma, and the main clause starts with its verb again.
tips[1].title: Hear the umlaut and the double infinitive
tips[1].text: hätte, wäre, könnte, müsste, wüsste, käme — front vowels, dots. …hätte anrufen können: two infinitives, modal last.
tips[1].check.why: An unreal condition needs the Konjunktiv II, and the umlaut makes it: wüsste, not the past tense wusste.
tips[2].title: The comma is the pause
tips[2].text: Wenn ich mehr Zeit hätte, | würde ich … — write the comma at the pause, and the next word is a verb.
tips[2].check.why: The wenn-clause ends with its verb cluster (gekommen wärst); the comma follows it, and the main clause opens with its verb hättest.
remember[0]: Shape from the first word; comma at the pause; verb after it.
remember[1]: hätte / wäre with dots; modal as infinitive at the end.
exam: Unreal conditions run through the opinion texts of the B2 exam and through your own e-mails — spelling hätte / wäre and placing the verbs right is basic accuracy.
tips[2].check.q: Where does the comma go? 'Wenn du früher gekommen wärst hättest du ihn noch gesehen'
